claimed.name: BSVKey Inference MCP
claimed.summary: MCP server that sells Claude/Grok tokens paid in BSV. Two modes: prepaid BRC-100 channel (draw down per token) or x402/BRC-121 per-call. Signed usage receipts verified offline against byte counts; charge recomputed client-side, fails closed. Routes through the hosted gateway inference.bsvkey.com (self-host hook BSVKEY_BASE_URL exists, unproven).
